en: This image shows a busy street scene in a small town, with several people walking and crossing a wide, unpaved road. To the left, there's a row of low-rise commercial buildings with awnings and signage, including a prominent 'VIVO' store sign and a shop labeled 'LINSKAFEL'. On the right, a blue and yellow bus or van is parked. In the background, the street leads uphill and is lined with trees. At the top of the hill, there is a notable clock tower structure, likely part of a church or public building, surrounded by pine trees. The image has a hand-colored aesthetic, typical of mid-20th-century European postcards.
